entries.source: A Septuagesima usque ad Pascha, loco Alleluia dicitur: Laus tibi, Domine, Rex aeternae gloriae.
entries.english: From Septuagesima until Easter, instead of Alleluia is said: Praise be to Thee, O Lord, King of everlasting glory.

entries.source: A Septuagesima usque ad Pascha, loco Alleluia, dicitur:
entries.english: From Septuagesima until Easter, instead of Alleluia, is said:

entries.source: Ad Completorium.
entries.english: At Compline.

entries.source: Ad Mattutinum.
entries.english: At Matins.

entries.source: Ad Omnes.
entries.english: At all the Hours.

entries.source: Adsit nobis, quaesumus, Domine, virtus Spiritus sancti, quae et corda nostra clementer expurget, et ab omnibus tueatur adversis. Per Dominum.
entries.english: May the power of the Holy Ghost be with us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, both mercifully to cleanse our hearts and to defend us from all adversity. Through our Lord.

entries.source: Alia
entries.english: Another

entries.source: Amen.
entries.english: Amen.

entries.source: Amor Jesu accendat praecordia nostra. Amen.
entries.english: May the love of Jesus enkindle our hearts. Amen.

entries.source: Ant. Benedicta sit sancta creatrix et gubernatrix omnium, sancta et individua Trinitas, nunc et semper, et per infinita saecula saeculorum. Amen.
entries.english: Ant. Blessed be the holy Trinity, Creator and Ruler of all things, holy and undivided, now and always, and unto infinite ages of ages. Amen.

entries.source: Ant. Charitas Pater est, gratia Filius, communicatio Spiritus Sanctus. Veritas est Pater, veritas Filius, veritas Spiritus Sanctus. Pater et Filius et Spiritus Sanctus una substantia est, o beata Trinitas.
entries.english: Ant. The Father is charity, the Son is grace, the Holy Ghost is communion. The Father is truth, the Son is truth, the Holy Ghost is truth. The Father and the Son and the Holy Ghost are one substance, O blessed Trinity.

entries.source: Ant. Gloria Patri, qui creavit nos; gloria Filio, qui redemit nos; gloria Spiritui Sancto, qui sanctificavit nos; gloria summae et individuae Trinitati, Deo nostro in saecula saeculorum.
entries.english: Ant. Glory be to the Father, who created us; glory be to the Son, who redeemed us; glory be to the Holy Ghost, who sanctified us; glory be to the supreme and undivided Trinity, our God, world without end.

entries.source: Ant. Gratias tibi, Deus, gratias tibi, vera et una Trinitas, una et summa Deitas, sancta et una Unitas.
entries.english: Ant. Thanks be to Thee, O God, thanks be to Thee, true and one Trinity, one and supreme Godhead, holy and one Unity.

entries.source: Ant. Illuminare his, etc. cum Oratione, ut supra.
entries.english: Ant. To give light to them, etc., with the prayer, as above.

entries.source: Ant. Te Deum Patrem ingenitum, te Filium unigenitum, te Spiritum Sanctum Paraclitum, sanctam et individuam Trinitatem, toto corde et ore confitemur, laudamus atque benedicimus, tibi gloria in saecula.
entries.english: Ant. Thee, God the Father unbegotten, Thee, the only-begotten Son, Thee, the Holy Ghost the Paraclete, the holy and undivided Trinity, with our whole heart and mouth we confess, praise and bless; to Thee be glory unto the ages.

entries.source: Ant. Te invocamus, te laudamus, te adoramus, spes nostra, honor noster, libera nos, vivifica nos, o beata Trinitas.
entries.english: Ant. Thee we invoke, Thee we praise, Thee we adore, our hope, our honour; deliver us, give us life, O blessed Trinity.

entries.source: Ant. Tibi laus, tibi gloria, tibi gratiarum actio in saecula sempiterna: et benedictum nomen gloriae tuae, sanctum et laudabile, superexaltatum in saecula, o beata Trinitas.
entries.english: Ant. To Thee be praise, to Thee be glory, to Thee be thanksgiving unto everlasting ages: and blessed be the name of Thy glory, holy and worthy of praise, exalted above all unto the ages, O blessed Trinity.

entries.source: Ant. Veni, sancte Spiritus, reple tuorum corda fidelium, et tui amoris in eis ignem accende.
entries.english: Ant. Come, Holy Ghost, fill the hearts of Thy faithful, and kindle in them the fire of Thy love.

entries.source: Ante conclusionem Gloria tibi, Domine, additur:
entries.english: Before the conclusion Glory be to Thee, O Lord, is added:

entries.english: Ant. Come, Holy Ghost.

entries.english: Hail Mary, etc. As of all who rejoice, etc.

entries.english: Blessed be the holy and undivided Trinity, now and always, and unto infinite ages of ages. Amen.

entries.source: Benedicti sint sancti Joachim et Anna, ex quibus benedicta Virgo Maria sine originali labe concepta et nata est.
entries.english: Blessed be Saints Joachim and Anne, of whom the Blessed Virgin Mary was conceived without original stain and born.

entries.source: Capitulum
entries.english: Little Chapter

entries.source: Capitulum (Rom. 5)
entries.english: Little Chapter (Rom. 5)

entries.source: Caritas Dei diffusa est in cordibus nostris per Spiritum Sanctum qui datus est nobis.
entries.english: The charity of God is poured forth in our hearts by the Holy Ghost, Who is given to us.

entries.source: Coeleste beneficium introivit in Annam, ex qua nobis nata est B. V. Maria.
entries.english: A heavenly blessing entered into Anne, of whom the Blessed Virgin Mary was born unto us.

entries.source:
Da dexteram surgentibus,
Exurgat ut mens sobria,
Flagrans et in laudem Dei
Grates rependat debitas.
entries.english:
Give Thy right hand to those who arise,
That a sober mind may rise up,
Burning, and in praise of God
Rendering the thanks that are due.

entries.source: Deus, qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Thomae, confessoris tui atque doctoris, mira eruditione clarificas, et sancta operatione foecundas: da nobis, quaesumus, et quae docuit, intellectu conspicere, et quae egit, imitatione complere. Per Christum Dominum nostrum. Amen.
entries.english: O God, Who dost enlighten Thy Church by the wondrous learning of blessed Thomas, Thy Confessor and Doctor, and make her fruitful through his holy deeds: grant us, we beseech Thee, both to understand what he taught and to fulfil in imitation what he did. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

entries.source: Deus, qui conspicis, quia nos undique mala nostra perturbant, praesta, quaesumus, ut beati Ludgeri Confessoris tui atque Pontificis intercessio gloriosa nos protegat. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum Filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum. Amen.
entries.english: O God, Who seest that our evils trouble us on every side, grant, we beseech Thee, that the glorious intercession of blessed Ludger, Thy Confessor and Bishop, may protect us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.

entries.source: Deus, qui per caritatem beati Joannis Dei infirmis, pauperibus, et afflictis clementer subvenisti: concede propitius, ut ejus meritis et precibus ab omni semper infirmitate, periculo, et adversitate misericorditer protegamur et liberemur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, etc.
entries.english: O God, Who through the charity of blessed John of God didst graciously succour the sick, the poor, and the afflicted: mercifully grant that by his merits and prayers we may always be protected and delivered from every infirmity, danger, and adversity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, etc.

entries.source: Dexterae Dei digitus, virtus spiritualis, Nos defendat, eruat ab omnibus malis, Ut nobis non noceat daemon infernalis, Protegat et nutriat, foveatque sub alis.
entries.english:
May the Finger of the right hand of God, spiritual power,
Defend us and deliver us from all evils,
That the infernal demon may do us no harm;
May He protect and nourish us, and cherish us beneath His wings.

entries.source: Diffusa est gratia in labiis tuis: propterea benedixit te Deus in aeternum.
entries.english: Grace is poured abroad in thy lips: therefore hath God blessed thee for ever.

entries.source: Domine Jesu Christe, Fili Dei vivi, pone Passionem, Crucem, et mortem tuam inter judicium tuum, et animam meam, nunc, et in hora mortis meae: et mihi largiri digneris gratiam, et misericordiam: vivis, et defunctis requiem, et veniam: Ecclesiae tuae pacem, et concordiam; et nobis peccatoribus vitam, et gloriam sempiternam. Qui vivis et regnas in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
entries.english: O Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, place Thy Passion, Cross, and death between Thy judgment and my soul, now and at the hour of my death: and vouchsafe to bestow upon me grace and mercy; upon the living and the departed, rest and pardon; upon Thy Church, peace and concord; and upon us sinners, life and everlasting glory. Who livest and reignest for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.source: Domine Jesu Christe, etc., ut supra.
entries.english: O Lord Jesus Christ, etc., as above.

entries.source: Dudum sacrata pectora Tua replesti gratia: Dimitte nostra crimina, Et da quieta tempora.
entries.english: Of old Thou didst fill consecrated hearts with Thy grace: forgive our sins, and grant peaceful times.

entries.source: Ecclesiae tuae Domine, preces placatus admitte: ut destructis adversitatibus et erroribus universis, secura tibi serviat libertate.
entries.english: Graciously receive, O Lord, the prayers of Thy Church: that, all adversities and errors being overcome, she may serve Thee in freedom and security.

entries.source: Gloria Patri, etc.
entries.english: Glory be to the Father, etc.

entries.source: Gloria in excelsis Deo etc.
entries.english: Glory to God in the highest, etc.

entries.source: Gloria tibi, Domine, Qui natus es de Virgine, Cum Patre, et Sancto Spiritu, In sempiterna saecula. Amen.
entries.english: Glory be to Thee, O Lord, Who wast born of the Virgin, with the Father and the Holy Ghost, for everlasting ages. Amen.

entries.source:
Gloria tibi, Trinitas,
Aequalis, una Deitas;
Et ante omnia saecula,
Et nunc, et in perpetuum.
entries.english:
Glory be to Thee, O Trinity,
Equal, one Godhead;
Both before all ages,
And now, and for ever.

entries.source: Has horas canonicas cum devotione, Tibi, sancte Spiritus, pia ratione, Dixi, ut nos visites inspiratione, Et vivamus jugiter in coeli regione.
entries.english:
These canonical Hours I have said with devotion,
Unto Thee, O Holy Ghost, with pious intent,
That Thou mayest visit us with Thine inspiration,
And that we may live for ever in the realm of heaven.

entries.source:
Has horas canonicas cum devotione.
Dixi, sancta Trinitas, tui ratione,
Ut sis mihi praesens mortis in agone.
Et regnemus jugiter in coeli regione. Amen.
entries.english:
These canonical Hours I have said with devotion,
O holy Trinity, for Thy sake,
That Thou mayest be present with me in the agony of death,
And that we may reign for ever in the realm of heaven. Amen.

entries.source: Hymnus
entries.english: Hymn

entries.source: Hymnus.
entries.english: Hymn.

entries.source: Ineffabilem misericordiam tuam Domine nobis clementer ostende: ut simul nos et a peccatis exuas, et a poenis et a tribulationibus quas pro his meremur eripias, et pacem tuam nostris concede temporibus: et nos famulos tuos ab omni adversitate custodi. Per Dominum nostrum, Jesum Christum, Filium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus, per omnia secula seculorum.
entries.english: Graciously show us Thine ineffable mercy, O Lord: that Thou mayest both free us from our sins and rescue us from the punishments and tribulations which we deserve for them; grant Thy peace in our times, and guard us, Thy servants, from all adversity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

entries.source: Jesus, Maria, Anna.
entries.english: Jesus, Mary, Anne.

entries.source: Kyrie, eleison. Christe, eleison. Kyrie, eleison.
entries.english: Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Lord, have mercy.

entries.source: Laudate Dominum in Sanctis ejus: laudate eum in firmamento virtutis ejus.
entries.english: Praise the Lord in His holy places: praise Him in the firmament of His power.

entries.source: Laudemus viros gloriosos, et parentes nostros in generatione sua.
entries.english: Let us praise glorious men, and our fathers in their generation.

entries.source: Laus Patri, etc., ut supra.
entries.english: Praise be to the Father, etc., as above.

entries.source: Laus tibi, Domine, Rex aeternae gloriae.
entries.english: Praise be to Thee, O Lord, King of everlasting glory.

entries.source: Maria Mater gratiae, Mater misericordiae: Tu nos ab hoste protege, Et hora mortis suscipe.
entries.english: Mary, Mother of grace, Mother of mercy: protect us from the enemy, and receive us at the hour of death.

entries.source: Memento salutis Auctor, Quod nostri quondam corporis, Ex illibata Virgine Nascendo, formam sumpseris.
entries.english: Remember, O Author of salvation, that once, by being born of the spotless Virgin, Thou didst take the form of our body.

entries.source: Mille Jesu perennanti, Mille grates sint Tonanti, Flaminique tot honores, Sempiternum quot amores Fovet alma Trinitas.
entries.english: A thousand thanks be unto everlasting Jesus, a thousand unto the Father Who thundereth; and unto the Spirit as many honours as the loving Trinity cherisheth acts of love eternally.

entries.source: Nobis sancti Spiritus gratia sit data, De qua Virgo virginum fuit obumbrata, Cum per sanctum Angelum fuit salutata. Verbum caro factum est, Virgo foecundata.
entries.english:
May the grace of the Holy Ghost be given unto us,
By which the Virgin of virgins was overshadowed,
When by the holy Angel she was greeted.
The Word was made flesh; the Virgin became fruitful.

entries.source:
O lux beata Trinitas,
Et principalis unitas,
Jam sol recedit igneus;
Infunde lumen cordibus.
entries.english:
O blessed Light, O Trinity,
And sovereign Unity,
Now the fiery sun withdraweth;
Pour Thy light into our hearts.

entries.source: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui dedisti famulis tuis in confessione verae fidei aeternae Trinitatis gloriam agnoscere, et in potentia Majestatis adorare Unitatem, quaesumus, ut ejusdem fidei firmitate ab omnibus semper muniamur adversis. Per Dominum.
entries.english: Almighty and everlasting God, who hast granted Thy servants, in the confession of the true faith, to acknowledge the glory of the eternal Trinity, and in the power of Thy Majesty to adore the Unity, we beseech Thee that, by steadfastness in this same faith, we may ever be defended from all adversity. Through our Lord.

entries.english: Let us pray. O God, Who Thy servant, etc., as above.

entries.source: Oremus, Famulorum tuorum, Domine, delictis ignosce, ut qui tibi placere de actibus nostris non valemus, genetricis Filii tui Domini Dei nostri intercessione salvemur.
entries.english: Let us pray. Forgive, O Lord, the offences of Thy servants, that we, who cannot please Thee by our own deeds, may be saved through the intercession of the Mother of Thy Son, our Lord and God.

entries.source: Oremus.

entries.english: We beseech Thee, Maker of all things, in this paschal joy defend Thy people from every assault of death.

entries.english: Response

entries.source: Sagittae tuae infixae sunt mihi, et confirmasti super me manum tuam.
entries.english: Thy arrows are fastened in me, and Thou hast laid Thy hand firmly upon me.

entries.source: Sancte Michael Archangele, defende me in praelio, ut non peream in tremendo judicio. Amen.
entries.english: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend me in battle, that I may not perish in the dreadful judgment. Amen.

entries.source: Sancti nominis tui, Domine, timorem pariter et amorem fac nos habere perpetuum; quia nunquam tua gubernatione destituis, quos in soliditate tuae dilectionis instituis. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum.
entries.english: Grant us, O Lord, a lasting fear and love alike of Thy holy Name; for Thou never withdrawest Thy governance from those whom Thou establishest in the steadfastness of Thy love. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

entries.source: Septiformem gratiam tunc acceptaverunt, Quare idiomata cuncta cognoverunt, Ad diversa climata mundi recesserunt, Et fidem Catholicam tunc praedicaverunt.
entries.english:
Then they received the sevenfold grace,
Whereby they understood all tongues;
They went forth unto the diverse regions of the world,
And then preached the Catholic faith.

entries.source: Spiritus Paraclitus fuit appellatus, Donum Dei, charitas, fons vivificatus, Spiritualis unctio, ignis inflammatus, Septiformis gratia, charisma vocatus.
entries.english:
The Spirit was called the Paraclete,
The Gift of God, charity, a quickened fount,
Spiritual anointing, burning fire,
Sevenfold grace, and a gift of grace.

entries.source: Spiritus Paraclitus nos velit juvare, Gressus nostros regere et illuminare, Ut cum Deus venerit omnes judicare, Nos velit ad dexteram omnes appellare.
entries.english:
May the Spirit, the Paraclete, deign to help us,
To direct and illumine our steps,
That, when God shall come to judge all men,
He may deign to call us all unto His right hand.

entries.source: Spiritus sancti gratia illuminet sensus et corda nostra. Amen.
entries.english: May the grace of the Holy Ghost illumine our senses and our hearts. Amen.

entries.source:
Summae Deus clementiae,
Mundi que factor machinae,
Unus potentialiter,
Trinusque personaliter.
entries.english:
O God of highest clemency,
And Maker of the fabric of the world,
One in power,
And Three in Persons.

entries.source: Suum sanctum Spiritum Deus delegavit, In die Pentecostes Apostolos confortavit, Et de linguis igneis ipsos inflammavit, Relinquere orphanos eos denegavit.
entries.english:
God sent His Holy Spirit,
On the day of Pentecost He strengthened the Apostles,
And with fiery tongues He set them aflame;
He refused to leave them as orphans.

entries.source:
Te mane laudum carmine,
Te deprecamur vespere,
Te nostra supplex gloria
Per cuncta laudet saecula.
entries.english:
Thee in the morning with a song of praise,
Thee in the evening we beseech;
May our humble praise
Laud Thee throughout all ages.

entries.source: Tu esto nostrum gaudium, Qui es futurus praemium: Sit nostra in te gloria Per cuncta semper saecula.
entries.english: Be Thou our joy, Who art to be our reward: may our glory be in Thee through all ages for ever.

entries.source:
Tu, Trinitatis unitas,
Orbem potenter quae regis,
Attende laudis canticum
Quod excubantes psallimus.
entries.english:
Thou, Unity of the Trinity,
Who rulest the world with might,
Attend to the song of praise
Which we sing as we keep watch.

entries.source: Vas electionis est mihi iste etc.
entries.english: This man is unto Me a vessel of election, etc.

entries.source: Veni Creator Spiritus, Mentes tuorum visita, Imple superna gratia, Quae tu creasti pectora.
entries.english: Come, Creator Spirit, visit the minds of Thy faithful; fill with heavenly grace the hearts which Thou hast created.
